summary: This class addresses a Hanukkah minhag of saying the berakhah Lehadlik Ner Hanukkah and beginning lighting before saying the rest of the berakhot. It discusses sources from Keter Shem Tob, De'ah VeHaskel, Shulchan Hamelech, Ben Ish Hai, and Masechet Soferim. It explains how this practice is rooted in both peshat and sod.

questions: What is the custom recorded in Keter Shem Tob regarding Hanukkah berakhot?
Which sources support saying Lehadlik Ner Hanukkah and lighting before saying the remaining berakhot?
How does Masechet Soferim describe the sequence of berakhot on Hanukkah?
What did Rabbi Laniado and the Ben Ish Hai write about Hanukkah lighting practices?
